title: Normalized tensor descent for exact functors
statement: For two ringed sites with object universe u+1, morphism universe u and coefficients u+1, an additive exact small-colimit-preserving module functor L with a natural ordinary tensor isomorphism mu preserving flat-term K-flat resolving complexes admits a TensorComparison on its fixed exact-derived model. For arbitrary normalized source and target tensor models and their normalized shifts, the comparison satisfies its resolving-pair representative equation and both signed integer-shift squares. These are the models and equations of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction-data].

lean.statement:
theorem exactTensorComparison_exists (L : Mod R ⥤ Mod S) [L.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L]
    [PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} L]
    (a : TensorModel R) (b : TensorModel S) (sa : TensorShifts a) (sb : TensorShifts b)
    (mu : ∀ M N : Mod R, L.obj (((tensor R).obj M).obj N) ≅
      ((tensor S).obj (L.obj M)).obj (L.obj N))
    (hn : ∀ {M M' N N' : Mod R} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N'),
      L.map (((tensor R).map f).app N ≫ ((tensor R).obj M').map g) ≫
        (mu M' N').hom =
      (mu M N).hom ≫ (((tensor S).map (L.map f)).app (L.obj N) ≫
        ((tensor S).obj (L.obj M')).map (L.map g)))
    (hp : ∀ P, resolving R P → resolving S ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) :
    ∃ t : TensorComparison L (exactTensorModel L) a b mu,
      TensorComparisonShifts t (sa := sa) (sb := sb) (sd := inferInstance)
